role: Typed async event bus with priority-based dispatch and hybrid error handling
detail: Generic infrastructure for async event publishing and subscription. Core classes: EventPriority (IntEnum with LOW=0, NORMAL=1, HIGH=2, CRITICAL=3 for handler dispatch ordering), Event (frozen dataclass base type with auto-populated UTC timestamp), and EventBus (main dispatcher). EventBus.subscribe() registers handlers per event type with priority and critical flag; handlers are called by publish() in descending priority order with stable sort preserving registration order within equal priorities. Error handling: critical=True (default) logs at ERROR and re-raises, halting dispatch; critical=False logs at CRITICAL and continues dispatch, exception never propagates. publish() does exact type matching (no subclass dispatch), sorts handlers once per publish, and sequentially invokes them. Includes unsubscribe() for handler removal and handler_count property.
gotchas: No subclass type matching in handlers — exact type required; duplicate registrations allowed and caller must avoid them; unsubscribe removes only first match if handler registered multiple times
